body:
## Hexagon HTP

Microsoft-signed HTP catalog (llama.cpp @ `e467e5`). No cert import required on Windows on Snapdragon.

## What's Changed

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/qualcomm/GenieX/compare/v0.9.0...v0.9.1
